description: This file is part of a Git-related project and contains functions for pruning packed objects and loose object files, including progress display and conditional removal based on options.

methods.name: int prune_subdir(unsigned int nr,const char * path,void * data)
methods.description: Recursively prunes directories, removing subdirectory if not in dry-run mode, with progress display.

methods.name: int prune_object(const struct object_id * oid,const char * path,void * data)
methods.description: Determines whether an object file is part of a pack and deletes or displays the removal command accordingly.

methods.name: void prune_packed_objects(int opts)
methods.description: Main function orchestrating the pruning process based on provided options, utilizing progress display.

ctags.name: prune_object
ctags.pattern: /^static int prune_object(const struct object_id *oid, const char *path,$/
ctags.signature: (const struct object_id * oid,const char * path,void * data)

ctags.name: prune_subdir
